cards.question: Does chart-only GRPO keep its reasoning past update 2,000? The photos + charts model collapsed to about 10 tokens between updates 1,750 and 2,000 of 2,844, while the chart-only model stopped at 1,844, so mixing and training length are confounded.
cards.change: 2,844 updates instead of 1,844 on ChartQA alone: the mixture's horizon and learning-rate schedule
cards.predicted: Holds. End-of-run dev answers stay above half the 1,844-update model's length and dev accuracy within 2 points of it: chart questions reward reasoning, and the collapse came from the photo questions' pressure toward short answers. Answers keep shortening slowly, as they did from 198 tokens at update 300 to 162 at 1,844.
cards.holds_if: end-of-run dev tokens >= 50% of the baseline's and dev accuracy >= baseline - 2 points
cards.if_holds: Mixing caused the collapse: run the prompt-routing and ratio cards.
cards.if_not: Long-run RL instability, not mixing: no ratio cards; the finding becomes when to stop.
cards.why: Observed: 1,000 more updates leave dev accuracy where it was (75.8) and answers do not collapse. They lengthen after update 1,250 (137 to 179 tokens), so the predicted slow shortening was wrong.
cards.implies: The collapse comes from mixing, not length. Next: prompt routing and one other ratio. Chart-only training gains nothing past 1,844 updates.

cards.question: Does SFT on reasoning traces close GRPO's lead on ChartQA, given the same information RL has: the model's own samples and the checker?
cards.change: SFT on one correct reasoning sample per question from Instruct 2B, instead of GRPO
cards.predicted: Holds. GRPO stays at least 2 points ahead on dev. Correct traces lift SFT above Instruct and keep its reasoning, but one offline pass cannot sharpen the way repeated on-policy updates do.
cards.holds_if: SFT on traces ends at least 2 dev points below the chart-only GRPO model
cards.if_holds: The chart win stands against SFT on reasoning traces.
cards.if_not: The win comes from the reasoning targets rather than from RL, and the root claim changes.

cards.question: Does SFT on a larger model's reasoning traces close GRPO's lead on ChartQA?
cards.change: SFT on one correct reasoning sample per question from Instruct 8B, instead of GRPO
cards.predicted: Holds. GRPO stays at least 2 points ahead on dev, with this arm at or above SFT on 2B's traces: a stronger teacher improves the targets, and the student still gets one offline pass.
cards.holds_if: SFT on 8B traces ends at least 2 dev points below the chart-only GRPO model
cards.if_holds: The chart win stands even against a larger teacher's traces.
cards.if_not: A larger teacher can replace RL at 2B on charts; compare against 2B self-traces to separate teacher size from targets.

cards.question: Does a mixed model keep chart reasoning when each dataset rolls out under its own prompt?
cards.change: Photos roll out under the short prompt and charts under the reasoning prompt, on the mixture's pool and 2,844 updates
cards.predicted: Holds. Chart answers stay above half the chart-only length and ChartQA dev within 2 points of it: photo questions no longer have reasoning to delete, so their pressure toward short answers is gone.
cards.holds_if: end-of-run ChartQA dev tokens >= 50% of the chart-only control's and dev accuracy >= its accuracy - 2 points
cards.if_holds: One model can keep both behaviors under routed prompts; apply the 8B gate.
cards.if_not: Sharing weights is enough to carry the pressure across prompts; a mixed hero run is off the table.

cards.question: Does a mixed model keep chart reasoning under one prompt when photos are only 10% of the pool?
cards.change: 90% charts and 10% photos instead of 65% and 35%, all under the reasoning prompt, 2,844 updates
cards.predicted: Does not hold. Fewer photos delay the collapse, as 65% charts delayed it by about 1,500 updates, but one prompt still pays for short answers on some questions and 2,844 updates are long enough to reach it.
cards.holds_if: end-of-run ChartQA dev tokens >= 50% of the chart-only control's and dev accuracy >= its accuracy - 2 points
cards.if_holds: Ratio alone protects chart reasoning; check what it costs on photos.
cards.if_not: Ratio only delays the collapse; routing is the recipe to carry forward.
